title: Private In-Home Pasta Workshop
subtitle: Experience Authentic Italian Pasta Making in Your Own Kitchen
intro: Love the rustic texture of traditional pasta with its perfect ridges that capture every drop of sauce? Join our intimate in-home cooking workshop and master the art of handcrafted Italian pasta! I'll bring generations of Southern Italian culinary heritage directly to your home — perfect for all skill levels, no previous experience required.
whatYouCreate: Handmade water-based pasta dough from scratch
Traditional shapes: orecchiette, cavatelli, busiate, and more
A complementary sauce using fresh, seasonal ingredients
skills: Hand-shaping techniques using simple household tools
included: QR code with the complete recipe you've mastered
Expert instruction from a passionate Italian cook
A relaxed, joyful atmosphere — no prior experience needed!
closingNote: We'll conclude by enjoying the delicious meal you've all prepared together.
